text: Lior Beres Juli Je Yes my understanding is that all private conversions (i.e. Reform and Masorti, as well as private Orthodox) need to go through a court process to be recognised by PIBA, but usually it is just a very straightforward and non-contentious declaratory judgment proceeding. I see the Reform movement lists the cost of this as 1,700 NIS. I am not sure why ITIM is charging so much more - it may be because the Reform movement provides pro-bono legal help for preparing the application, whereas ITIM doesn't and so needs to pay a lawyer.
